title: Ensure 'Do not apply the Mark of the Web tag to files copied from insecure sources' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\File Explorer\Do not apply the Mark of the Web tag to files copied from insecure sources to 'Disabled'
reason: MOTW is an important security feature that ensures files from insecure locations are treated with extra caution.

title: Ensure 'Turn off Data Execution Prevention for Explorer' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\File Explorer\Turn off Data Execution Prevention for Explorer to 'Disabled'
reason: Data Execution Prevention is an important security feature supported by Explorer that helps to limit the impact of certain types of malware.

title: Ensure 'Turn off heap termination on corruption' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\File Explorer\Turn off heap termination on corruption to 'Disabled'
reason: Allowing an application to function after its session has become corrupt increases the risk posture to the system.

title: Ensure 'Turn off shell protocol protected mode' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\File Explorer\Turn off shell protocol protected mode to 'Disabled'
reason: Limiting the opening of files and folders to a limited set reduces the attack surface of the system.
